narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: You brought da elixir!! T'anks, friend. You come all this way to help Sos'mol. No ogre ever done that before. Sos'mol will remember this. Pay you back someday. Me promise.
